messages.subject: installing shiny server
parts:
hello

I'm new to shiny - I'm trying to follow the tutorial to set up the most basic shiny application, but I can't seem to set up the server correctly. Can someone give me the basic steps for how to set up the right folder/directory and then run an empty shiny application? 

Thanks,
Ted

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: installing shiny server
parts:
Oh, Ted, I think maybe there's been a misunderstanding. You don't need
Shiny Server until your app is done and you want to make it available
to other people (i.e., deploy it on the web or on an intranet). To
make and use your own Shiny apps, you don't need Shiny Server, and I
don't recommend you worry about Shiny Server until you have figured
out how Shiny works.

The most minimal Shiny app looks like this: You make a folder (say,
"myapp") and in that folder you create a file called ui.R and another
called server.R. Make the ui.R contain this:

shinyUI("Hello world")

And put this in server.R:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
})

Then start an R session, and run these lines:

library(shiny)
runApp("path/to/myapp")

replacing path/to/myapp with the file path to the myapp folder. That
should automatically launch a web browser and the page should say
"Hello world". Now you should be ready to continue following the
tutorial.
